bootstrap.pairing: same resampled sample_id multiset for BASE, RC1, and RC_KEEP
bootstrap.metric_recompute: sum per-sample frozen-evaluator counts, then recompute F1; never average per-sample F1
bootstrap.point_metric_basis: sum counts over the complete frozen 150-sample denominator, then recompute the metric

limitations: Sensitivity only: this 149-sample paired analysis is not a replacement for the pre-registered 150-sample main analysis.
